title: Pipeline Configuration File
description: Schema for the pipeline.config.json file read at service startup. Values may reference environment variables with the ${VAR_NAME} syntax; unresolved references cause config loading to fail at startup rather than defaulting silently.

connections.description: Named upstream connections keyed by connection name. Each key becomes addressable from job definitions.

PipelineSettings.description: Top-level execution settings for the job pipeline.

concurrency.description: Number of jobs allowed to run simultaneously. Values above the worker count waste memory without adding throughput.

retryCount.description: Number of retry attempts for failed jobs; defaults to 3 attempts when omitted. Set to 0 to fail fast with no retries, which is recommended for jobs with side effects that are not idempotent.

retryBackoffSeconds.description: Base delay between retries; each successive retry doubles the delay up to a five minute ceiling.

timeoutSeconds.description: Hard wall-clock limit per job. Jobs exceeding the limit are killed and counted as failures for retry purposes.

LoggingSettings.description: Controls the structured log output of the pipeline runner.

level.description: Logging verbosity; one of debug, info, warn, or error. The fatal level from v1 config files is no longer accepted and should be rewritten to error during migration.

format.description: Output encoding. Use json in production so the collector can parse fields; text is meant for local development terminals.

redactKeys.description: Field names whose values are replaced with a redaction marker before a log line is written. Matching is exact and case-sensitive.

url.description: Connection URL. Credentials belong in environment references, never inline in the file.

poolSize.description: Maximum open connections kept in the pool for this upstream.

healthcheckPath.description: Optional HTTP path probed before the connection is marked ready at startup.
